product_images.product_image_1: The product is the unchanged central hero, with perfectly preserved geometry, materials, proportions, and branding. Create an ultra-premium, minimal editorial hero image for a premium pet brand homepage banner. Composition: product centered and dominant, slightly angled (10–15°) or subtly elevated on a low plinth; preserve true proportions with no distortion; generous negative space for copy. Camera: 50–85mm lens look, shallow-to-moderate DOF with the product and branding tack-sharp and fully legible. Lighting: premium studio softbox lighting—soft highlights revealing material texture, gentle fill for label readability, subtle rim light for separation; clean grounded contact shadow; no glare over branding. Background: clean, tactile option—soft neutral gradient (warm ivory to taupe), subtle fabric texture (linen/canvas), or smooth matte surface—minimal, calm, and non-branded. Mood: luxurious yet approachable, pet-safe, modern DTC. No props, no pet hair mess, no clutter, no third-party logos, no distortion, no added parts. Optional minimal typography only in negative space, small and refined.
product_images.product_image_2: The product is the unchanged central hero, with perfectly preserved geometry, materials, proportions, and branding. Design a feature-driven campaign image for the pet product with a clean, engineered DTC layout. Place the product prominently (center or slightly right-of-center), large and tack-sharp with branding readable. Background: visually engaging but controlled and use-evocative—generic cozy home surface cues (clean feeding area mat texture, soft rug blur, tidy corner) or minimal play-space tones; keep it non-specific and non-branded (no recognizable bowls/toys unless the product itself is one). Lighting: bright, natural editorial feel with soft shadows; controlled highlights; no harsh hotspots on branding. Add a headline (2–4 words) and short tagline (5–9 words) in modern friendly typography placed in negative space (avoid “Best” claims). Include a structured feature list of exactly 3 items with simple icons/checkmarks (e.g., “Durable”, “Pet-Safe Materials”, “Easy to Clean”) using generic, compliant language; align to a strict grid with ample padding and optional soft translucent panel behind text only. No clutter, no third-party logos, no distortion, no added parts.
product_images.product_image_3: The product is the unchanged central hero, with perfectly preserved geometry, materials, proportions, and branding. Create a benefits-driven campaign image that evokes care, comfort, and engagement through subtle, premium metaphors. Composition: product dominant and tack-sharp with branding legible; generous negative space; clean contact shadow. Add ONE restrained benefit metaphor behind the product only: a soft comfort ‘halo’ gradient, gentle motion arcs suggesting play/engagement, or a calm cozy light band implying relaxation—abstract, premium, and never touching/obscuring the product. Lighting: bright, diffused, editorial with clean highlights and soft shadow edges; avoid glow bloom over branding. Overlay one concise emotionally resonant headline plus 2–3 short benefit lines in clean modern type placed in negative space, aligned to a tidy grid; never over branding. Background: soft neutral gradient with subtle organic texture, non-branded. No clutter, no specific scenarios, no distortion, no added parts.
product_images.product_image_4: The product is the unchanged central hero, with perfectly preserved geometry, materials, proportions, and branding. Create a bold, conversion-focused campaign image communicating value and trust with premium hierarchy and whitespace. Arrange the product neatly on a minimalist studio surface (off-white, soft gray, warm neutral gradient), perfectly aligned; product tack-sharp and fully legible. Lighting: balanced diffused studio light with subtle rim highlights and grounded shadow; controlled reflections; no glare on branding. No clutter, no third-party logos, no distortion, no added parts.
product_images.product_image_5: The product is the unchanged central hero, with perfectly preserved geometry, materials, proportions, and branding. Create a premium, human-centered editorial image showing the product being handled in a clean, neutral environment with a subtle hint of pet use (without needing to show a pet). Include one well-groomed hand interacting in a physically plausible way—holding, placing, opening/adjusting only if the product truly has those parts—keeping branding unobstructed and readable. Camera: 35–85mm lens look (avoid wide-angle distortion), shallow DOF with the product tack-sharp and the sharpest element; hand slightly softer if needed. Lighting: natural window-like daylight mixed with soft warm ambient fill; gentle shadows; realistic skin tones; controlled highlights on materials. Background: minimal and softly blurred (neutral tabletop, soft fabric edge) with no logos and no clutter. Optional micro-tagline: at most 1 short line in refined type placed in negative space, never over the product. No distortion, no added parts.
